# Fixture catalogue

- `meeting-email.json` — reply choice, draft and hybrid email/calendar action.
- `hotel-research.json` — comparison UI and AI follow-up actions without booking.
- `waiting-for-architect.json` — overdue promise and follow-up draft.
- `passport-renewal.json` — novel workflow composed entirely from stock blocks.
- `athens-working.json` — operator work in progress with no premature action.
- `stuck-pdf.json` — plain-language failure and recovery.
- `project-resurfacing.json` — durable open loop originating from prior conversation context.

Use these as seed and regression vectors. IDs are deterministic test UUIDs.
